Passion lies in bridging technology and sustainability. At EcoCart, I’m driven by the goal of making e-commerce smarter, greener, and more efficient. Every project is an opportunity to turn data into action—whether it’s optimizing delivery routes or refining customer experiences.  

Currently, I’m building scalable machine learning models that enhance personalization while reducing environmental impact. My work spans from refining recommendation systems to streamlining backend workflows, all while ensuring seamless integration with cloud infrastructure.  

In the past year, I’ve contributed to a 22% improvement in recommendation accuracy by leveraging PyTorch and TensorFlow, and automated deployment pipelines using Docker and Kubernetes. I’ve also optimized AWS resources to cut compute costs by 15%, enabling faster model iterations.  

Looking ahead, I’m eager to collaborate on projects that merge innovation with purpose. Whether it’s advancing NLP for smarter user interactions or exploring new ways to scale ML operations, I’m excited to grow alongside teams that prioritize impact over metrics. Let’s build the future—one algorithm at a time.
